Where can I find your full shipping policy?
You can find our shipping details and policies in our help center on our website, as well as on each product page below the “Add to Cart” button where delivery estimates are displayed.
Here is an overview of our core shipping policy:
Where We Ship: We ship across all 10 Canadian provinces, every US state except Hawaii, Alaska, and the US Virgin Islands, and select areas in Australia (New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia, with postal code confirmation for ACT). We do not ship to the Northern Territory, Western Australia, or Tasmania.
Cost: Standard shipping is free with no minimum purchase required. In rare cases, customers in remote areas may incur additional delivery fees, which are automatically calculated at checkout based on postal code.
Delivery Service: Couriers provide doorstep delivery to the front door of a house or the lobby of an apartment/condo on weekdays (excluding statutory holidays). Delivery partners do not carry boxes to individual unit doors, assist with assembly, or remove old furniture.
Timelines: Estimated delivery dates depend on stock availability for your chosen fabric and configuration. Once your items leave the warehouse, delivery typically takes a few days.

What's your return and refund policy?
Here are the key details of our return and refund policy:
30-Day Risk-Free Trial: All items (including rugs) come with a 30-day trial starting the day you receive them. If your item isn't the right fit, you can return it free of charge, as long as it is sent back in its original packaging.
Mattress 100-Night Trial: Mattresses include a 100-night trial. We arrange pickup, and the original packaging does not need to be kept for mattress returns.
Packaging & Potential Fees: Returns are free during the 30-day trial with the original packaging. If original boxes are missing, a replacement-box fee of 15% of the value of the items needing new boxes (up to a maximum of $150) will be deducted from your refund. Significant customer-caused damage or modifications may also result in a fee.

What's your warranty policy on defective items?
We offer a 5-year limited warranty on all of our products.
Here are the key details of what it covers and its conditions:
Coverage: The warranty covers manufacturing defects, non-consumer-caused damage, and structural issues, including frame defects.
Exclusions & Voiding Conditions: The warranty does not cover accidental damages or issues caused by the consumer. It is considered void if damage results from accidents, mishandling, improper assembly, neglect, misuse (such as not securing the seat module with the provided arms), or using modules in unintended ways.
Modifications: Any alterations or modifications void the warranty, including structural changes, alterations to the upholstery or fabric, or using non-Cozey parts.
For accidental damage like rips, tears, or stains, we offer an optional extended protection plan called CozeyProtection+, which can be purchased separately before your items are sent out.
